claim: Where Build hangs a wall's tile: a one-sided wall from its sector's ceiling; the upper step of a two-sided wall from the NEXT sector's ceiling (the head of the opening); the lower step from the next sector's floor. Wall cstat 4 instead pegs the band to this sector's own ceiling (both bands, on a two-sided wall). So a banded facade breaks phase over every opening unless the header carries cstat 4.
evidence: NBlood/source/build/src/engine.cpp:4438-4441 (setup_globals_wall2) globalzd from topzref unless (globalorientation&4); the calls at :4721 (upper: nextsec ceiling / sec ceiling), :4835 (lower: nextsec floor / sec ceiling), :4940-4942 (one-sided: sec ceiling / sec floor, so cstat 4 pegs a one-sided wall to its floor)

E3M1 sets bit 4 on 21 of its 35 street headers by projects/blood-city/level/facade_pass.py:213 (a comment, its count not kept); knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_e3m1_headers.py over every wall of an E3M1 sky sector onto a lower roofed ceiling: 23 of 47
use: Set cstat 4 on the wall over a street opening when the facade is banded; the texture frame depends on it rather than deciding it.
